comments.author: Smajlec
comments.body_html: I think Amands’s might override some of the effects of this mod, as it’s a bit more aggressive with enforcing it’s changes. My tweaks to exposure and vignette should still apply because Amands’s doesn’t affect these. I haven’t tested it because AFAIK there is no official version of Amands’s for 4.0.

comments.author: Smajlec
comments.body_html: AFAIK there is no official Amands’s for 4.0. This mod can be a lightweight alternative to Amands’s, as it only changes the color grading and shouldn’t affect performance (it might even slightly improve it as it disables some of BSG’s post-processing). This mod has some tweaks that are not present in Amands’s but I don’t know if these mods will work well together.
